chunks: Stepdaughters are haram (forbidden) to you, whether they were raised in your household or not.

key_terms.أَوْ لَمْ يَكُنَّ: or whether that was not the case
key_terms.عَلَيْكُمْ: upon you; in relation to your legal responsibility
key_terms.فِي الْحِجْرِ: in the household or under guardianship

ai.seo_question: Are stepdaughters forbidden in marriage even if they were not raised in the household?
ai.summary: This hadith states the legal prohibition of marrying stepdaughters. It clarifies that this ruling applies whether or not they were raised in the man's household, making it a direct ruling in marriage family law.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.4448 - Imam Ali ibn Abi Talib (as) said:
"Stepdaughters are prohibited for you, whether they were raised in your household or not."
